findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, list_commercial_services, get_project_testimonials, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, list_blog_tags_and_categories, list_reviews, check_permit_requirements, list_permit_jurisdictions, get_permit_timeline, get_common_plan_review_corrections, search_content · Private data: get_business_info, submit_contact_request, list_permit_jurisdictions, lookup_parcel_by_address, answer_permit_question, get_permit_timeline, get_author_bio · Public sink: get_blog_post, list_blog_tags_and_categories, submit_contact_request, get_common_plan_review_corrections, request_walkthrough.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, list_commercial_services, get_project_testimonials, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, list_blog_tags_and_categories, list_reviews, check_permit_requirements, list_permit_jurisdictions, get_permit_timeline, get_common_plan_review_corrections, search_content · Private data: get_business_info, submit_contact_request, list_permit_jurisdictions, lookup_parcel_by_address, answer_permit_question, get_permit_timeline, get_author_bio · Public sink: get_blog_post, list_blog_tags_and_categories, submit_contact_request, get_common_plan_review_corrections, request_walkthrough

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
